measures.notes: Contra Costa County posts each local measure as one HTML page (question, analysis, arguments, rebuttals, and full text where printed). These pages are not linked from the county's Nov 3, 2026 election page (its candidate/measure list is a JS widget with no documents); they are listed by the site's own search, which is the found_on page. The measure is only the appointive-treasurer question, so the city resolution is the only 'text'. The city's election page also links separate PDFs of the analysis and each argument/rebuttal; not listed since the county page holds them.
